_why: Digests of names that belong to private work and must never appear in this public repository. Never written out: a plaintext list of what a company is hiding is the leak this check exists to prevent, and a check naming its own terms reports itself on every run. Enforced by tests/private_references.rs. To add a term: `printf '%s' <term> | shasum -a 256` and record it with its length.
